purpose: Verify the complete fixed-lateral discrete derivative chain before inverse design, including a nonstationary displacement observable
parameterization: c(X)=theta0+theta1*cos(2*pi*x)+theta2*cos(2*pi*y)+theta3*cos(2*pi*z), L=1; positive level-set width, not physical wall thickness
failure_policy: Save failed diagnostics and stop; no tolerance relaxation or automatic larger-grid sweep. No optimization before derivative acceptance.
scope: Reverse-mode first derivatives on fixed meshes, fixed macro strain and uncalibrated theta. No differentiated volume bisection, free-lateral derivative, binary geometry gradient, optimization, or new Abaqus jobs in this batch. N4/N8 check derivative correctness at each discrete problem, not continuum gradient convergence.
